entries.title: Deadlink

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Deadlink launched first on Windows PC and later came to PS5 and Xbox Series X/S; the PC version keeps the highest-fidelity, highest-control capture route with no sourced console-exclusive content.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Deadlink on Steam or GOG for Windows PC and keep it updated; use the console versions only if a couch/controller route is preferred.

all_releases.reason: primary: first full release and best archive/capture route; no exclusive content is sourced for later console ports.
skip: same core content family; PC remains the preferred fidelity/capture route.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Xbox Series X/S console port.
all_releases.reason: skip: same core content family; PC remains the preferred fidelity/capture route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced platform-exclusive campaign or mode content is documented for the console ports.

entries.remaster_caveats: Console ports are later release routes, not separate remasters or definitive editions.
